{{Top}}
'''Holodisplays''' were portable [[Hologram/Legends|three-dimensional]] display systems used by the denizens of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Smaller holodisplays were often interconnected with computer access terminals, while larger models could be used in command centers.
